description: Drainage - Virtual Drainlines is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Virtual Drainlines are used to maintain network connectivity when conveyance features are absent. For example, if a stormwater pond has both inlet and outlet conveyance pipes, a virtual drainline is used to connect the inlet and outlet pipes through the pond. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are drainlines, drainage. The table has 21 columns. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
